fields.name: firm_name
fields.description: Name used in the analysis. Renamed firms are merged with their predecessors (for example Bullet Time Ventures into Techstars Ventures).

fields.name: holder_type
fields.description: Holder category. Only core_venture firms can be ranked; for the two holders with lines of more than one type, the predominant type.

fields.name: measurement_status
fields.description: ranked: in the main value-per-dollar ranking; listed_separately: measured the same way but outside the definition of an independent venture manager; not_scored_no_fund_history: core venture holder without a fund history; not_measured_holder_type: growth, crossover, hedge, mutual-fund, corporate, sovereign and other holders.

fields.name: separate_listing_group
fields.description: For listed_separately firms, the group they are reported in: identified_by_odin (firms Odin identified as outside the standard definition), same_test (firms failing the same test), newly_measured_v7 (holders measured in report version 7), family_office_or_individual.

fields.name: reason_not_ranked
fields.description: Why a measured firm is not ranked, or why a core venture holder is not scored.

fields.name: has_fund_history
fields.description: True if fund_vehicles.csv holds the firm's fund history.

fields.name: counts_as_venture_fund
fields.description: True if the firm's holdings count as venture funds in listing_venture_summary.csv: core venture holders less money of individuals and families (family offices, angel groups, members' deal platforms and principals' own vehicles).

fields.name: n_listings
fields.description: Number of listings in which the firm has a holder line.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What changed for this firm across versions and key judgments behind its figures (measured firms only).
